race.comment: REOFFER (12) was only beaten by a short head here fresh up after setting the pace and then was less than 2 lengths off the winner when fourth at Strathalbyn 3 weeks ago. A nasty gate won't help, but she is still worth including to be safe. MISS KASEI (11) showed talent, if a bit on the weak side, when trained in Victoria, and she makes her South Australian debut here with 2 trials under her belt. She might want a touch further than 1000m, but she can still win this. HEART OF THE MED (7) was put aside to mature after 2 starts last season, winning on debut. She is stronger now and has been close up in a couple of tune-up trials. The blinkers are on, and she should be right in the finish fresh. CHARKA (4) strips fitter second up and is another top 4 chance in an even contest. RICH BRITT (3) has the blinkers on for the first time, and she can bounce back into the top 4.
